obligations.expected_behavior: For every non-empty Consumer Manifest, complete every route transition that is applicable to that manifest.
forbidden_result: Any applicable route transition remains incomplete for a non-empty Consumer Manifest.
A non-empty Consumer Manifest is excluded from the completion measurement.
obligations.observable_result: Each non-empty Consumer Manifest has a completion record for every applicable route transition, with an aggregate completion rate of 100%.
obligations.state_after: All applicable route transitions for every non-empty Consumer Manifest are completed.
obligations.state_before: A non-empty Consumer Manifest has applicable route transitions pending completion.
obligations.subject: Non-empty Consumer Manifest route-transition processing
obligations.trigger: When a non-empty Consumer Manifest is processed for its applicable route transitions.

obligations.expected_behavior: After rollback, observe the Prior Behavior Baseline for every non-empty Consumer Manifest covered by the rollback flow.
forbidden_result: Rollback completes without observing the Prior Behavior Baseline.
Any applicable non-empty Consumer Manifest lacks a post-rollback baseline observation.
obligations.observable_result: A post-rollback verification record shows Prior Behavior Baseline observation for 100% of applicable non-empty Consumer Manifests.
obligations.state_after: The Prior Behavior Baseline has been observed and recorded after rollback for every applicable non-empty Consumer Manifest.
obligations.state_before: Rollback has occurred for a non-empty Consumer Manifest and its Prior Behavior Baseline is available for observation.
obligations.subject: Post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline verification
obligations.trigger: After rollback of an applicable route transition for a non-empty Consumer Manifest.

obligations.expected_behavior: Preserve historical evidence associated with the route transitions, rollback, and baseline observation for every non-empty Consumer Manifest.
forbidden_result: Historical evidence is deleted, truncated, or otherwise lost during or after rollback.
The required completion or baseline verification cannot be supported by retained historical evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Historical evidence remains available and unchanged enough to verify route-transition completion and post-rollback Prior Behavior Baseline observation for all non-empty Consumer Manifests.
obligations.state_after: Historical evidence for the completed transitions and post-rollback baseline observations is retained without loss.
obligations.state_before: Historical evidence exists for the non-empty Consumer Manifest route-transition and rollback flow before the required preservation boundary.
obligations.subject: Historical evidence retention
obligations.trigger: During and after route-transition rollback and post-rollback baseline verification.
